column3: writes the byte at 0x1DA300 through a literal address: as a symbol gcc moves the store into the jal's delay slot, which retail does not; NTSC-U has it at 0x1DA380
NTSC-U adds 0x78 to the word at D_L19_001DF240 where PAL adds 0x64; the twin pairing masks that immediate as an address low half (lui/lw/addiu on one register), so the bytes differ in a constant
